exposure: Suture material (black silk, polypropylene, polyglactin 910, chromic catgut)
Type of gynecological procedure (total abdominal hysterectomy, LSCS, laparoscopy, burch colposuspension, Fothergill repair)
outcome: Pathogens isolated from surgical site infections
cohort: 45 women who underwent selected gynecological procedures (total abdominal hysterectomy, LSCS, laparoscopy, burch colposuspension, Fothergill repair) using specific suture materials.
finding: Black silk was associated with the highest rate of surgical site infections, followed by polypropylene and polyglactin 910.
mod_finding: Emergency lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) was the procedure with the highest rate of surgical site infections.
